content.text:
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>question</interview_state>
<clarification_question>Le message d'erreur doit-il inclure le code de sortie (exit code) dans le fallback lorsque stderr et stdout sont vides, ou uniquement le message "Unable to <action>:" suivi du code de sortie ?</clarification_question>
</proposed_plan>

```xml
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>ready</interview_state>

## Approved decisions

- **Error message format**: `Unable to <action>: [stderr] message\n[stdout] message` with real newline, stderr before stdout, both flows trimmed and included only if non-empty
- **Fallback format**: `Unable to <action>: exit code N` when both stderr and stdout are empty
- **Success behavior**: unchanged (no modification to success cases)
- **Private interfaces**: preserved as-is, no access to private/any members
- **Test scope**: 5 PUBLIC tests in `acp-sandbox/test/runtime.test.ts` for `runCodex` using `fakeExecutor/sandboxScenario` with `sbx create` (not `--help`)
- **Test cases**: two flows, stderr only, stdout only, none, success
- **Environment**: `npm ci` and `npm test` at ROOT, real exit codes, no tsx, no tail without pipefail
- **File constraints**: no package/lock/dependency changes, update existing expectations only
- **Review scope**: diff from BASE of the run, approved docs only, `acp.implementation-result/v1` and `acp.verification-report/v1` formats
- **Pipeline**: full complete, no historical commit audit, targeted verification only
- **Artifacts**: one ticket in `.scratch` required, no ADR/glossary updates
- **Reading constraints**: targeted reads max 100 lines, avoid audits/transcriptions
</proposed_plan>
```
